name: The Condition
summary: You move into an old house for three months, and everything seems peaceful… until you notice the door you must never open. From the very first day, unexplained noises, fleeting shadows, and objects that move on their own begin to haunt you. The line between reality and paranoia blurs as you explore the house, and every unexpected sound heightens the tension. In The Condition, your choices and curiosity confront a mystery that defies logic and tests your sanity. Some rules are meant never to be broken… will you dare to discover what lies behind the door?
